 The Credits: “The Arrival”
 Shai Gilgeous-Alexander’s 20-point game streak comes to an end, the Sixers are rolling and much more
 by Jackson Frank Oct 23, 2026, 7:14 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The 2026-27 NBA season is here.
 The Boston Celtics blew a big lead Tuesday afternoon to open the year 0-1. The Philadelphia 76ers have knocked off last year’s Eastern Conference champs and runner-ups in three days. Tyrese Haliburton dropped 23 points and 12 assists in his return to action. And the Lakers opened the season by blowing out the Warriors and helping make Yaxel Lendeborg’s rookie debut a memorable one .
 Here are some of the best stories of the opening week of the season as well as key news you may have missed.

 Jayson Tatum’s season debut was far from pristine, but there’s no reason to panic — CelticsBlog
